fact: The minister presented a draft 2026 digital budget of 27.2 billion FCFA (down 6.32% from 29.034 billion in 2025), with the Digital programme at 12.3 billion and continued broadband coverage of the whole territory, including phase 2 of the high and very high speed deployment.
title: Benin Cuts 2026 Digital Budget but Prioritizes AI, Broadband Rollout
